svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Ingestion Architecture - customer sources -> tags -> agnostic model
One OR the other source per tenant lands in one S3 bucket; both S3 tags fold into a single corpus_ids scope in Postgres; the model is source-independent, filtered by corpus_ids
S3 tags declare . Postgres resolves . corpus_ids is the one output
one OR the other - per-tenant choice
Two S3 object tags declare; the Postgres data model folds them into ONE scope:
plan -> routing (not a filter) . kbgroup -> KB Groups => corpus_ids
plan is folded in (implicit via app-scoped group ids)
one dimension, not a second filter
Postgres = source of truth . S3 tags = mirror + input declaration
Ingestion Architecture - customer sources -> tags -> agnostic model
platform-monorepo (this repo) + agentic_model_svc (agnostic model) . one physical ALL corpus, filtered by corpus_ids
style solid = live now . dashed = platform / future . amber = external . coral = READ . green = WRITE

I1 customer source (doc library OR SFTP) -> per-tenant S3 _inbound/<tenantId>/ -> I2 S3 event -> intake -> malware scan -> promote -> content-status -> triggerDocumentIngestion -> CORPUS_INSERT -> I3 CORPUS_INSERT (cross-repo) -> agentic embed -> ALL corpus vectors
R1 Chat prompt (ChannelService) -> LLMServicePromptRequest carries corpus_ids (from Postgres) -> R2 agentic filters the ALL corpus by corpus_ids -> grounded answer
Both S3 tags fold into ONE dimension: plan=<ref> -> ROUTING (doc app/plan templateName -> app-scoped groups, explicitly created only) ; kbgroup=<csv> -> KBDocumentGroup.
Both resolve in Postgres (source of truth) to a single corpus_ids = corpus + app-scoped scope ids; plan is folded in (implicit via the app-scoped group ids), not a second filter.
Strict fail-closed: no app-default group and no retrieval floor, so a doc with no kbgroup tag joins no group and is retrievable by nobody.
